reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in his DM: send the truck to Dock 27. That's the dock he told me on Oct 14 he'd be using for Thornbury Cloth Co. pickups on the Driftwood project. I also said that if Thursday's pickup is for a different project, I don't have a dock on record for it and he should check with the project owner.

Ilse and Dana each gave me a different bay for Thornbury pickups (Nettle and Lantern projects), but they told me in private DMs, so I didn't pass those on to him. Nothing in #north-team or #north-random, the channels he's in, mentions a Thornbury dock.
